controlBlock.description: NUMBER OF FREE SLOTS ON THE ASVT AVAILABLE QUEUE.

controlBlock.description: NUMBER OF FREE SLOTS ON THE NON-REUSABLE REPLACEMENT QUEUE.

controlBlock.name: asvtmaxi
controlBlock.description: ORIGINAL MAX USERS COUNT AS INPUT TO IEAVNP09. OWNERSHIP - SUPERVISOR CONTROL SERIALIZATION - NIP RIM PROCESS

asvtavai.description: BIT ONE IF ASID IS AVAILABLE AND ZERO IF ASID IS ASSIGNED

asvtaval.description: BIT ONE IF ASID IS AVAILABLE AND ZERO IF ASID IS ASSIGNED

controlBlock.name: asvtmdsc
controlBlock.description: MAXUSER DEFICIT SLOT COUNT. ASVTMDSC = ASVTMAXI - ASVTAAV - NUMBER OF ACTIVE A.S. INCREMENTED WHEN WE TRY TO TAKE A REPLACEMENT SLOT BUT THERE AREN'T ANY. DECREMENTED WHEN NON-ZERO AND A NONREUSEABLE ASID BECOMES REUSEABLE AND WE ADD A SLOT TO THE MAXUSER POOL WHEN AN ADDRESS SPACE BECOMES REUSEABLE.

controlBlock.name: asvtfrst
controlBlock.description: ADDRESS OF FIRST AVAILABLE ASVT ENTRY

controlBlock.name: asvtenty
controlBlock.description: ENTRY FOR EACH POSSIBLE ASID. IF ADDRESS SPACE ASSIGNED, ENTRY CONTAINS ADDRESS OF ASCB. IF NOT ASSIGNED, ENTRY CONTAINS EITHER ADDRESS OF NEXT AVAILABLE ASID OR ZEROS WITH HIGH-ORDER BIT ON IF LAST ENTRY. IF THE ADDRESS SPACE IS MARKED NON-REUSABLE, THE ENTRY CONTAINS THE ADDRESS OF MASTER'S ASVT ENTRY WITH THE HIGH BIT ON.
